baseline: Original-query dense E5 + Chroma, same B corpus

experiment_1.name: clean_scope_dense
experiment_1.hypothesis: An explicit chapter prefix can distract semantic search and duplicate an existing metadata filter.
experiment_1.change: Remove leading Theo chương 3/4 only when the same chapter is already present in the supplied filter. Keep filter and all remaining query text.

experiment_2.name: clean_scope_sentence_rerank
experiment_2.hypothesis: Whole-chunk embeddings can blur a relevant definition with neighboring material; source-sentence similarity may improve top-3 ordering.
experiment_2.change: Use experiment 1 candidates; score = 0.5 * dense cosine + 0.5 * max source-sentence cosine. Same E5 revision, passage/query prefixes, normalized vectors.
experiment_2.sentence_policy: punctuation followed by whitespace; preserve text offsets

comparison_policy: Report original and transformed queries, all per-question outcomes, strict Hit@1/Hit@3 and cost/time. No changes to corpus, gold or parameters based on test.
selection_scope: Exploratory dev retrieval only; final selection waits for context and real-agent evaluation. No automatic claim that either experiment improves quality.
